run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T09:26:30Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend (annotation value 2.622222222222222) is explained by a dependency failure on the ad service. frontend's error spans during the incident were confined to the ad path: increase over the 10m ending 09:40 was 306.58 each for span 'GET', 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and 'GET /api/data', plus 6.45 for 'tcp.connect', while its CartService/CheckoutService client spans and 'GET /api/cart'/'POST /api/cart' had 0 error spans. frontend's error-span rate was 0 at every step from 09:01:30 through 09:25:30 and first became non-zero at 09:26:00 (4.7/s), immediately before the 09:26:30 alert start. The ad Deployment has replicas=1, and its only pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 is Running but not ready with restartCount 4, lastState.terminated reason OOMKilled and exitCode 137 finished 09:27:44 (current state also terminated OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finished 09:28:46); kubelet logged 23 Warning BackOff 'Back-off restarting failed container ad' events from 09:25:44 to 09:33:23. The ad Service Endpoints listed only notReadyAddresses, i.e. no ready backend. ad's 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' span rate fell from ~1.0-1.4/s to 0 by the 09:28 point. ad's container memory rose steadily from 331,190,272 to 371,867,648 bytes between 09:00:30 and 09:24:30 against a 450Mi limit. All five nodes reported MemoryPressure=False, no other otel-demo pod showed OOMKilled, and frontend's non-error span rate did not increase. frontend-proxy showed concurrent error spans on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'.

claims.text: frontend emitted STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans during the incident: increase of 1232.78276 error spans over the 10m ending 09:40, decomposed as 'GET' 306.5821, 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' 306.5821, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' 306.5821, 'GET /api/data' 306.5821 and 'tcp.connect' 6.45436, while 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem', 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder', 'GET /api/cart' and 'POST /api/cart' each had 0 error spans.

frontend had no error spans before the incident inside the window: the frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate was 0 at every step from 09:01:30 through 09:25:30, and the 1m-window series first became non-zero at 09:26:00 with 4.7/s, just before the alert start of 09:26:30.

In the 10m ending 09:40 frontend server-side 'GET' spans were 306.5821 ERROR against 2608.637166666667 STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and 'GET /api/data' spans were 306.5821 ERROR against 0 UNSET, localizing the failing path to /api/data.

The ad service stopped serving: ad's 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' span rate was ~0.68-1.41/s through the 09:26 point, fell to 0.2 at 09:27 and was 0 from 09:28 onward, and the per-service query for the 10m ending 09:40 returned ad STATUS_CODE_UNSET 0 and STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0, whereas a 30m window still showed 829.3737373333333 earlier GetAds spans.

Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 is in phase Running but ready=false with restartCount 4; its container's lastState.terminated is reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finished 09:27:44, its current state is also terminated OOMKilled with exitCode 137 finished 09:28:46, and its Ready and ContainersReady conditions are False with reason ContainersNotReady since 09:28:47.

Kubelet events for ad-554b849958-l9ft5 include a Warning BackOff event 'Back-off restarting failed container ad in pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5_otel-demo' with count 23 spanning 09:25:44 to 09:33:23, alongside 6 'Started container ad' events, the last at 09:30:15.

The ad Service has no ready backend: its Endpoints object for service 'ad' lists only notReadyAddresses [ip 100.96.2.230, nodeName i-0d81a0f472ebdc704, targetRef Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5] on port 8080 named tcp-service, with no ready addresses.

Deployment ad has spec.replicas 1, status.replicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1 and condition Available=False since 09:28:47 with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable; container 'ad' runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi and requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi, strategy RollingUpdate, observedGeneration 1.

Before the crash the ad container's memory grew steadily: container_memory_working_set_bytes for container ad rose from 331190272 bytes at 09:00:30 to 371867648 bytes at 09:24:30, and container_memory_usage_bytes rose from 331931648 at 09:01:00 to 372006912 by 09:24:00-09:29:00; after the restarts the series show new instances at about 183910400, 123707392 and 189317120 bytes.

The newest readable ad container log lines (up to 09:24:35) show normal request handling such as 'Targeted ad request received for [books]' and 'Non-targeted ad request received, preparing random response.' interleaved with 'no baggage found in context'; no error, panic or OOM text appeared among the 40 newest of 2678 lines shown.

Among the 21 otel-demo pods, only ad-554b849958-l9ft5 has a non-empty last termination reason (OOMKilled) and it is the only pod listed as ready=false; frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx and frontend-proxy pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-xfrh6 are both Running and ready with restartCount 0.

frontend-proxy emitted its own error spans in the same window: 'ingress' 305.50637333333333 and 'router frontend egress' 303.35492 error spans per 10m, and its error-span rate rose from ~0.0037-0.0111/s before 09:26 to ~1.79/s at the 09:38 point, in step with frontend's rise to ~3.6/s.

No error spans were observed for the other traced services in the 10m ending 09:40: cart, checkout, product-catalog, currency, payment, shipping, email, accounting, quote and image-provider all reported STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 0, as did ad.
All five cluster nodes report MemoryPressure=False with reason KubeletHasSufficientMemory and Ready=True, including i-0d81a0f472ebdc704, the node hosting the ad pod.

Primary causal chain: the single ad pod was OOMKilled and entered CrashLoopBackOff (BackOff from 09:25:44), leaving the ad Service with no ready endpoints; frontend's gRPC calls to oteldemo.AdService/GetAds then failed, setting error status on the /api/data request path and producing the frontend request error rate behind RequestErrorRate.

Deepest supported cause candidate: the ad container's memory grew steadily (~331MB to ~372MB between 09:00:30 and 09:24:30, roughly 1.6MiB/min) until it exceeded the 450Mi container memory limit and was OOMKilled; whether this is an application memory leak in image demo:2.1.3-ad or simply a limit too small for the workload cannot be separated with the available evidence.

Contributing factor candidate: Deployment ad runs with replicas=1, so the single OOMKilled container removes all ad capacity, as reflected by the ad Service endpoints containing only notReadyAddresses; no redundant replica absorbed the restart loop.

frontend-proxy's error spans on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' (305.50637333333333 and 303.35492 per 10m, versus frontend 'GET' 306.5821) are propagation of frontend's failing /api/data responses rather than an independent frontend-proxy fault; the propagation itself was not verified from span-level status codes or proxy logs.

Rejected: node-level memory pressure or a cluster-wide OOM event caused the crash. All five nodes report MemoryPressure=False and only the ad pod among the 21 otel-demo pods shows OOMKilled as its last termination reason.

Rejected: a traffic surge overloaded frontend or ad. frontend's non-error STATUS_CODE_UNSET span rate was ~43.5-46.3/s before the incident and ~39.2-42.9/s during it, and ad's GetAds rate held steady at ~1.0-1.4/s until it dropped to 0, so no request-rate increase accompanies the failures.

Rejected: frontend itself was broken by a crash or restart. Pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is ready with restartCount 0, and frontend's error spans are confined to the AdService client span and the /api/data path, with 0 errors on their CartService and CheckoutService client spans.

Rejected: the flagd EventStream error spans on ad, recommendation and fraud-detection contributed to this alert. At 09:15, before the incident, those spans already showed about 1.0526 error spans per 10m on all three services and at 09:40 they were about 1.0757, an unchanged background level not tied to the 09:26 onset.

ad's own server spans never carried an ERROR status: a 30m window showed STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 for 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', 'getAdsByCategory', 'getRandomAds' and 'resolve', and the 10m ending 09:40 showed ad ERROR 0 with UNSET 0. The ad-side failure therefore appears as absence of ad server spans plus frontend client-side errors ('grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' 306.5821 and 'tcp.connect' 6.45436 per 10m), not as server-side error status in ad.

gaps: The alerting rule 'RequestErrorRate' is not visible in this Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned status no_data with no rules, so the exact expression, threshold and metric basis of the alert (and the annotated value 2.622222222222222) could not be verified.

Jaeger returned no frontend spans inside the incident window: traces_search for 09:26-09:43 and traces_search_by_tags with error=true both returned status no_data, and an earlier frontend search's source data ended around 09:16:46, so span-level status detail for the failing GetAds calls is unknown.
frontend container logs could not be read - fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx returned status no_data with 0 lines and 0 bytes - so frontend's own error text was not verified.

The ad container's previous instance logs were unavailable and readable current-instance lines end at 09:24:35, so nothing is known about the seconds immediately before the 09:27:44 and 09:28:46 OOMKills.

Memory samples for the ad container plateau at 371867648 bytes around 09:24:30, so the exact peak at the OOM kill was not sampled; container_memory_failcnt and container_memory_failures_total returned 0, which may not reflect OOM kill counts.

Several Kubernetes series were absent from this Prometheus (status no_data): kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready for deployment ad, kube_pod_owner for the ad pod, kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total for the ad pod, and kube_pod_container_resource_limits for memory, plus kube_replicaset_owner had no series for owner_name=ad; the Deployment ad -> ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 -> pod chain is therefore taken from live object ownerReferences, not from metric history.

The rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count series and its rpc_service / rpc_grpc_status_code label values returned no data for frontend, so client-side gRPC status codes could not be read from metrics.

The change_history integration is not available, so it cannot be determined whether the ad image, its 450Mi memory limit or its application behaviour changed before the incident, or whether the memory growth is long-standing.
next_steps: Profile the ad application's memory use (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) to decide whether the steady growth is a leak, and compare its real need against the 450Mi limit and 225Mi request.
Consider raising the ad container memory limit and/or running more than one ad replica so a single container OOM does not remove all ad capacity.
Retrieve the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule definition for RequestErrorRate to confirm the exact error-rate expression and the value reported in the alert annotation.

After ad is stable, confirm recovery by checking that the ad Service has ready endpoints, ad GetAds spans resume, and frontend error spans on 'GET /api/data' and 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' return to 0.
